places-abriga-de-los-idolos-cueva-del-ti.story: 244 km from Nerpio to Nerpio, about 4 h 12 of riding. On the way it passes Cueva de las Palamas, Cueva del Tio Labrador and back through Cueva de las Palamas. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

legend-baltic-coast-scenic-road.slogan: Baltic Coast Scenic Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-baltic-coast-scenic-road.story: curated scenic road. Baltic coast, Hanseatic towns, beaches. From Lübeck it runs 185 km to Stralsund; allow about 3 h 22 of riding. It goes by way of Timmendorfer Strand, Wismar, Ostseebad Kühlungsborn and Warnemünde. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Baltic Coast Scenic Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 16 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
